CHOOSE BY WORKFLOW

Three ways to make the decision.

01

For a recurring workshop, compare the attendee roster, pack redemption and waitlist flow. Easy Appointment Booking explicitly advertises booking packs on Pro Plus, while Cowlendar lists bundles in its common feature set.

02

When several instructors need individual logins, calculate the total including staff charges. Unlimited team members on a plan does not automatically mean unlimited individual login accounts.

03

For a store that relies on Klaviyo or Shopify Flow, ask for a demonstration on the exact tier you intend to purchase. Easy Appointment Booking lists these on Ultimate; use that figure in your budget instead of the entry plan.

Before you switch, test these four things.

  1. Recreate a real booking. Include duration, buffer time, capacity and the assigned person or resource.
  2. Trigger a conflict. Block the same time in a connected calendar and verify the storefront response.
  3. Follow the money. Make a test payment, then cancel and check how the booking and refund are handled separately.
  4. Protect upcoming appointments. Confirm the import method with support, reconcile future bookings, and switch only after the new flow passes.
